pure-announcement.rationale: Though pegged to a launch, this is third-party coverage built on an author interview about design trade-offs — budget caps, triage separation, extension trust — that transfer beyond Vigolium itself.

duplicate.rationale: No nearest concept (SIEM gap, code-mode MCP, OSV, MCP governance) covers budgeting or triaging autonomous security agents.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The design claims are attributed on-record to the named author and checkable against the public AGPL repository.

durability.rationale: Matching budget-cap types to job shapes, the under/over-budget failure modes, and evidence-checked triage as a separate pass are trade-offs for agentic tooling that outlive the 235-module launch details.

actionability.rationale: 'Start tight and loosen only when genuine work is cut off', per-target budgets for broad sweeps, and a separate re-check pass that downgrades rather than drops uncertain findings are directly adoptable by anyone running LLM-driven scanners.

atomicity.rationale: It bundles at least two ideas that each stand alone — budget-capping autonomous auditors with its failure modes, and triage as a separate evidence-checking pass with merge-over-delete dedup — plus an extension-registry trust model; the split is the finding.
